public_rationale: Bloomberg's July 11, 2024 report describes a provisional levels framework and an internal demonstration that OpenAI believed showed new reasoning skills [e1]. Reuters's July 15, 2024 version reports sources' accounts of Q* demonstrations and an internal MATH score above 90%, while saying it could not link that score to Strawberry [e2]. These reports contain attributed capability claims, but do not independently establish a material breakthrough [e1] [e2]. They also do not establish that the underlying work lacked technical substance, so the characterization as hollow promotion remains unresolved [e1] [e2].
limitations: The supplied articles do not provide technical records that independently validate the reported demonstrations or benchmark result [e1] [e2].
The articles do not establish promotional intent or the absence of underlying technical progress [e1] [e2].
The claim specifies no technical threshold for a breakthrough.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The stories about OpenAI's Strawberry and AGI levels are marketing collateral, not reports of breakthroughs.

statement.excerpt: The problem is that these pieces aren’t about breakthroughs — they’re marketing collateral dressed up as technological progress, superficially-exciting yet hollow on the inside, which almost feels a little too on the nose.

from_speaker: marketing collateral dressed up as technological progress
our_interpretation: These pieces means the July 2024 Bloomberg levels report and Reuters Strawberry report discussed in the post.
The ordinary factual reading is that the stories promote unverified development claims rather than establish a substantial demonstrated technical advance.
Marketing collateral is treated as an assertion about promotional substance, not automatically as an allegation of payment or company authorship.
The target period covers the articles and their pre-post updates. Later releases cannot establish what the articles demonstrated at publication.
criteria.support_condition: The articles and underlying records establish that their apparent progress claims consisted of promotional plans without a substantiated material capability advance.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The reporting and its underlying records substantiate a material demonstrated advance, or establish a factual basis inconsistent with the characterization that the stories were substantively hollow promotion.
